name: Praevex
description: Praevex is a pre-engagement priming compound designed to be taken 10-15 minutes before anticipated combat, optimizing neuromuscular readiness, elevating baseline catecholamine levels to the high end of natural range, and sharpening threat-detection sensitivity without producing the jitteriness or narrowed focus of harder stimulants. It is the 'professional's warm-up' — it doesn't push past human limits, it ensures a human is operating at the top of their natural envelope when the moment arrives. Novafold markets it to licensed security professionals and law enforcement.
effects: Neuromuscular response optimized to natural peak
Baseline catecholamines elevated to high-natural range
Reduced pre-combat anxiety without eliminating it
side_effects: Relatively mild profile compared to harder compounds
Overconfidence in users who misread priming as enhancement
Disrupted sleep if taken within 6 hours of sleep
Diminishing returns with frequent use as baseline recalibrates
cultural_context: Praevex is the gateway drug of the combat pharmaceutical world — legal, relatively affordable, and normalized enough that licensed security workers take it before shifts the way office workers drink coffee. Its legitimacy makes it the first combat stim most runners try, and its mild profile makes it the baseline by which harder compounds are compared. On the Gray Zone it's used by people who can't afford anything stronger and by people disciplined enough to know that operating at natural peak is often enough. Novafold's decision to keep it legal and cheap is a calculated long-term market strategy — Praevex users become Novafold brand loyalists.
story_hooks: A Novafold executive is pushing to reclassify Praevex as prescription-only — the internal memo explaining why has leaked, and it implies they've found a long-term dependency mechanism they didn't disclose at approval

A runner realizes every crew they've worked with in the last year uses Praevex from the same distributor — and the distributor is keeping a list of who buys it, which amounts to a roster of active operators in the district

Someone has been adulterating a batch of Praevex moving through Tier 2 security channels with a slow-acting compound that degrades BCI handshake reliability under stress — the sabotage is surgical and the target is specific
